title: feat(plugin-audit): Setup has one audit entry, "Audit Log", and it opens the audit browser
body:
Fixes #23890

Clause-②: no

Item 1 of #23803, its `domain:services` half: Setup's Diagnostics group gets one audit entry, "Audit Log", and it opens the console's audit browser (`audit:log`). The browser's half (presets from the list views, and the "Open as list" link) is objectui#12667, already installed at the console pin `.objectui-sha` `5e15928b4631`, so this PR changes no objectui code.

## What this changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`: the Setup contribution had two entries onto `sys_audit_log`: `nav_audit_logs` ("Audit Logs", `type: 'object'`, the record list) and `nav_audit_log_browser` ("Audit Log Browser", `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'audit:log'`). It now has one: `nav_audit_logs`, `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'audit:log'`, label "Audit Log", icon `scroll-text` (the icon the page's own header draws). It still carries no item gate: it lives and dies with the plugin that owns `sys_audit_log`. The comment above it says why there is one entry, and where the list is reached instead.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-nav-contribution.test.ts`, rewritten around the card's acceptance:
  1. the contribution has exactly one item, `nav_audit_logs`, and it parses through `NavigationContributionSchema`;
  2. that item is `type: 'component'` with `componentRef: 'audit:log'` and label "Audit Log", a registry key, with no `objectName`, `requiresObject` or `requiresService`;
  3. **the rendered Setup nav has exactly one entry whose target is an audit surface.** The test folds `SETUP_APP`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`' `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` and the plugin's own contribution through the real `SchemaRegistry` (`getApp('setup')`, the fold `GET /api/v1/meta/app` reads). Over every leaf of that tree, the entries whose target is `audit:log`, the `sys_audit_log` object, or a URL onto either are exactly `['nav_audit_logs']`, in `group_diagnostics`, and `nav_audit_log_browser` is not served. Its control is that `nav_sessions` is in the same walk and the walk holds more than 10 leaves.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/vitest.config.ts`: `env: { OS_REGISTRY_LOG: 'warn' }` in the test block. `check:registry-log-declared` reads the suite as engine-booting once a test constructs a `SchemaRegistry`, and it asked for exactly this line (it went red on the first run without it).
- Translations in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/`:
  - `en.ts`: `nav_audit_logs` is "Audit Log", and `nav_audit_log_browser` is removed.
  - `zh-CN.ts`, `ja-JP.ts`, `es-ES.ts`: `nav_audit_log_browser` is removed. The `nav_audit_logs` value was re-checked against the new source: zh-CN 审计日志 and ja-JP 監査ログ already say "Audit Log", since neither language marks the plural. es-ES becomes "Registro de auditoría" (it was "Registros de Auditoría"). All three now match the `sys_audit_log` object's own label in `plugin-audit`'s generated bundles.
  - The three `*.source-hashes.ts` tables: the `nav_audit_logs` digest is re-recorded as `b2fad40733012b18` (`hashSource('Audit Log')`, computed with the package's own function, whose output for the old source "Audit Logs" equals the old recorded digest `700dd03639b82a6a`). The `nav_audit_log_browser` digest is removed.
  - `setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts`: `nav_audit_log_browser` joins `DEAD_SETUP_NAV_IDS`, with its reason in the header (seven ids become eight).
- `packages/cli/test/console-page-nav-entries.pin.test.ts`: the comment naming the plugin's page entry names `nav_audit_logs`. It is a comment-only change.
- Changeset `.changeset/23890-one-audit-entry.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch and `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, worded for administrators, with the `Clause-②: no` line.

## Which id survives, and why

The surviving id is `nav_audit_logs`, retargeted at the browser. Each reader of either id was measured at this branch's base `727091c82`:

| Reader | Keep `nav_audit_logs` | Keep `nav_audit_log_browser` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `platform-objects` labels and the three `*.source-hashes.ts` tables | one label re-sourced, the other id's keys removed | the same work, mirrored |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, item `access-security.audit-log-browser`, source `audit-plugin.ts#nav_audit_logs` | the anchor still resolves | `check:platform-checklist` goes red with ABSENT SYMBOL |
| `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` (`ids: ['nav_audit_logs']`, a `--self-test` fixture of `contributorsWithNoNavIds`, not a roster) | it still names a live id | it names a dead one (still green) |
| users' sidebar pins, which objectui stores as `nav:ID` favorites and matches by `item.id` (`useNavPins.ts` at the pin) | a pin on the older "Audit Logs" entry stays on the one entry | a pin on "Audit Log Browser" stays; a pin on "Audit Logs" no longer shows |
| objectui's console at the pin `5e15928b4631` | it routes by `type` and `componentRef`, never by id: `git grep` for either id answers 0, while the control `nav_approvals` answers 1 | the same |
| `console-page-nav-entries.pin.test.ts` comment | it needs a one-line edit | it stays true |

So keeping `nav_audit_logs` breaks no gate, keeps the established id's pins, and costs one comment edit.

## Measured before the change (premise)

- At the console pin, `apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx` builds its presets from the `sys_audit_log` document the console's metadata cache serves (`auditPresetsOf`). It links "Open as list" to `/apps/APP/sys_audit_log`, or to `…/view/KEY` when a preset is active. The metadata cache reads every object (`meta.getItems('object')`), and the object route resolves from all objects too (`AppContent.tsx`, `allObjects.find`). So neither the presets nor the list depend on a nav entry for the object.
- The parent card's other wire pin, `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` (`toHaveLength(32)`), does **not** move, and is not edited. It folds `SETUP_APP`, `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` and the MCP bundle only, and `plugin-audit` is not in that composition. After the change it passes unedited at 32.

## Verification, at head `669c95c49` (after merging `origin/main` at `7d6ec91d2`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: 55 files and 891 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). `audit-nav-contribution.test.ts` is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (counted with `--listFiles`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 73 files and 1136 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts test/console-page-nav-entries.pin.test.ts`: 2 files and 4 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:app-nav-i18n` (the gate that boots the real composition): OK, with 11 contributors and 4 locales. Setup has 52 merged nav ids and Account has 12, and every id is labelled in every locale.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths): 98 commands for the 16 changed paths. All 98 exited 0 at `669c95c49`. `--ran` gives "98 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: OK, with 3 anchors judged and 0 lost.
- Ablation, one leg. With `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, under the verify lock, a second Setup entry onto the list (`type: 'object'`, `objectName: 'sys_audit_log'`) is planted beside the one entry. The pin goes red as predicted: 2 failed and 1 passed. "contributes exactly one entry" and "the rendered Setup nav has exactly one entry whose target is an audit surface" each failed with `expected [ 'nav_audit_logs', …(1) ] to deeply equal [ 'nav_audit_logs' ]`. The entry-shape case stays green, as predicted, because it reads only the first item. The restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD (`9a3eb803ddc6`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. A first attempt was refused by the tool before any test ran, because its replacement contained its own anchor (anchor count 1 to 1), so nothing was measured that time.
- The exported language packs are typed `declare const en: TranslationData;` (and `zhCN`, `jaJP`, `esES`, `SetupAppTranslations: TranslationBundle`) in `packages/platform-objects/dist/apps/index.d.ts`. `grep -r` over the built `.d.ts` of `@objectstack/platform-objects` (22 files) and `@objectstack/plugin-audit` (2 files) finds 0 hits for `nav_audit_log_browser` and 0 for `nav_audit_logs`, while the control `TranslationData` has 2 hits. So no exported type names the removed key, and `Clause-②: no` holds: the change narrows a runtime value, not a published type.

CI's families are not re-run here: read them on this PR's checks.

## Outside the claim's declared file surface

Two additions, named here so the seat can keep or drop them.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/vitest.config.ts` (above): the gate's own prescription for the new test's `SchemaRegistry`.
- Commit `028b17966`, isolated: three texts this change makes false.
  - `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx`: the Diagnostics row reads "Audit Log — `plugin-audit`", and the notable-entries bullet describes the one entry and where the list is reached.
  - `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`: "Reading the trail" says Record Views is a preset of the browser that Diagnostics › Audit Log opens, with "Open as list" onto the view. It used to say "via the Audit Logs entry".
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, item `access-security.audit-log-browser`: step 5 no longer calls the object list "the nav entry", and names the Presets row and "Open as list". The `nav_audit_logs` source line says it opens this page. Revision 5 becomes 6 with a history entry, and no acceptance clause changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 4 of #23803 is not this PR's.** #23933 is still open at this PR's opening, so the 39-entry count and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`'s "45 Setup destinations" are left for whichever of the two lands last. For that re-measure: `check:app-nav-i18n` reads 52 merged Setup ids on this head's full composition (groups included, before any per-request filter).
- **The Setup palette's record search no longer covers audit rows.** objectui's ⌘K palette scopes record search to the active app's `type: 'object'` nav entries (`CommandPalette.tsx`, `searchableObjectNames`, at the pin). With the list entry gone, Setup's palette no longer searches `sys_audit_log` rows (`enable.searchable: true`). This follows from the ruling's "not from the nav"; the changeset says it. No card is filed.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` keeps its comment "Audit Logs (sys_audit_log) is contributed by @objectstack/plugin-audit". It is still true of the plugin and the object, so it is left alone (outside the surface).
- `plugin-audit`'s published `CHANGELOG.md` and `platform-objects`' published `CHANGELOG.md` describe `nav_audit_log_browser` as it shipped. They are release-owned and not edited.
